tagline: SOUTH ASIAN ROOTS. GLOBAL CLUB ENERGY.
genres: UK Garage / House / Afro House / South Asian Fusion
shortBio: K!SH is a DJ and producer blending South Asian musical influences with the energy of contemporary underground club music. Fusing UK Garage, House and Afro House with sounds from Punjabi, Bollywood and beyond, K!SH creates a distinctive crossover sound built for the dancefloor.
longBio:
K!SH is a DJ and producer exploring the intersection of South Asian musical influences and contemporary electronic club culture.

Blending the sounds of Punjabi, Bollywood and Bhangra with UK Garage, 140 beats, House and Afro House, K!SH creates a distinctive sound that connects familiar musical references with forward-thinking club production.

With around 25 years of experience behind the decks, K!SH brings a long-standing passion for electronic music into a new chapter as a DJ and producer. Drawing inspiration from the energy of the UK underground scene and the rich sounds of South Asian music, the focus is on creating sets that feel familiar yet unexpected, moving effortlessly between cultures, rhythms and genres.

Rooted in South Asian sounds. Driven by global club culture.
